title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
synopsis:
RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.\n
\n
(Source: J-Novel Club)
